# Divide Rational Polynomials

![Divide Rational Polynomials function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/polynomial/rational_divide.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Divide Rational Polynomials. G1/G2. Products are polynomial convolutions. All denominators must be nonzero; division also requires nonzero second numerator. No implicit common-factor cancellation. Coefficients are ascending powers. DBL/CDB promotion is explicit; input arrays are immutable. Empty coefficient vectors are errors unless explicitly documented.
